review_text: Hard water spots build up on the bowl within two days and I wipe it constantly.
Taking it apart for a deep clean is a two-person job. The pump housing will not budge.
The pump quit after five weeks. Just past the return window, of course.
It gurgles and rattles at 2am and I cannot sleep with it running in the room.
My senior cat refuses to go anywhere near it. Total waste for us.
Water seeps from the base seam onto my hardwood every single day.
Replacement filters cost more than I expected and I am buying them monthly.
The reservoir is tiny; I am refilling it every morning before work.
Slimy film coats the tube inside and I have to pull the whole thing apart to reach it.
There is a musty smell after a week even with fresh filters.
It hums louder than my old fountain. I keep it in the hallway now.
The filter slot is so tight that seating a new cartridge takes real force.
The pump cuts out randomly and I have to tap it to restart.
Finding this exact filter size locally is impossible; everything is online only.
Opening the lid to refill means detaching the cord each time. Annoying design.
Cleanup is genuinely quick - one rinse and a wipe and it is done.
Whisper quiet. I only hear a faint trickle if the room is silent.
Both of my cats took to it within an hour, even the picky one.
Three weeks in and zero leaks. The seal is solid.
The wide opening makes refilling from a pitcher completely mess-free.
Going on month four with the original pump still running strong.
Filters last about six weeks here, better than my previous fountain.
A steady output with no stuttering, even when the water level drops.
No film buildup inside after two weeks. Much better than our old plastic one.
Love how quiet it is, but cleaning the corners is a weekly fight.
My oversized cat drinks from it happily, though it leaks a little underneath.
Pump is holding up well, but filters are pricey and hard to find in stores.
Easy to refill thanks to the big opening, but it does hum at night.
No leaks at all, yet my skittish cat still will not approach it.
Deep cleaning takes effort, but the pump has been flawless for months.
Shipping box arrived crushed but the fountain itself was fine.
The app that pairs with it stopped syncing after an update.
Customer service took ten days to reply to my email.
It arrived with a EU plug adapter instead of a US one.
Not hard to clean at all - the smooth bowl wipes clean in seconds.
Zero noise complaints from us; if anything it is too quiet to notice.
The carbon dust from the new filter settled on the floor around it.
The replacement impeller is cheap but the shipping fee doubles the cost.
Refilling daily is fine for me since I am home all day anyway.
My kitten was startled by the first splash but plays with the stream now.
